name: Exotic, Relic and Unique Wargear
summary: High-tier equipment is intended as mission rewards, faction gifts, discoveries and campaign objectives. These items use the existing Availability and provenance rules rather than a separate currency. Exotic gear can sometimes be requisitioned; relics, archeotech and Unique items should usually enter play because the warband earned, recovered, inherited or stole them.
